text:
alex: Heads up — carrier just updated: AWB 123-987654321 is on customs hold in FRA, partial RMA batch (15/40 H100s). ETA slipped to 5/7 business days. Can vendor-ops confirm impact to our EU Dedicated pools?
maria: ugh. which serials are affected? we need to know if it's the reserved capacity units or loaners.
vendor-ops: confirmed list attached in portal, but quick summary: 8 reserved, 7 loaners. shipping manifest fragment: `H100-SN: H100-AX23..AX30` held.
sudhir: if reserved 8 gone that's ~18% throughput reduction for eu-west-1 gpu pools during peak windows. we should throttle noncritical batch jobs.
elaine: agreed. i'll toggle autoscale policy to prefer commit-tier traffic only, reduce burst to 0 for 24h. doing now. :white_check_mark:
chris: ops question — can we borrow 10 units from APAC spare pool temporarily? cross-region replication costs aside, might keep SLAs.
maria: APAC loaners require extra firmware parity checks; takes ~4 hours to validate, plus transfer lead time if we ask vendor to re-route.
vendor-ops: vendor can redirect 6 units from APAC to FRA air-express, cost delta +$12k per unit, ETA 48-72h after approval. they can also split the remaining 4 as sea freight but then 10+ day ETA.
alex: cost delta noted. what about on-site depot loaners? any local partners?
vendor-ops: depot in NL has 5 refurb units available, ready-to-ship same-day, but they're EOL firmware and need a BIOS patch. vendor recommends onsite swap with temporary compatibility shim.
sudhir: patching proc: `./bios_patch.sh --batch H100-REF-XXX` — estimate 2 engineers x 3 hours per 5 units including validation. Ops can handle.
elaine: runbook update: reduce pool size by 18%, enable fallback route to amd-gpu (if job tolerant), notify customers via console banner. I'll draft msg.
maria: vendor-ops — can we get a firm PO amendment & revised proforma that includes AWB, customs docs, and expedited surcharge? need to submit to finance.
vendor-ops: sending proforma now. invoice_ref: INV-2026-0897. includes surcharge line `EXPRESS_RMA=€96,000`.
alex: finance will want cheaper option — propose split: 6 air (critical) + 9 sea (noncritical) — vendor-ops, can you reduce air units to 6 and add a discount for combined shipment?
vendor-ops: can do 6 air + 9 sea. discount: 7% on combined logistics if we accept sea manifest consolidation. need approval by EOD CET.
chris: operational note — can we prioritize model-rerouting at the API layer to fall back to 70/30 lower-cost cluster mix? that buys us comfort without moving hardware.
sudhir: yes we have a canary rollout plan ready: `traffic_policy: {primary: eu-dedicated, fallback: eu-hosted, split: 70/30}`. we should enable for 12h to monitor error budget.
elaine: deployed canary policy, monitoring on. setting alert if p95 latency > 2.0s or token cost > 1.25x baseline.
maria: logistics-bot just posted updated AWB status: `logistics-bot: AWB 123-987654321 -> customs cleared 2026-03-19 17:02 CET, release ETA 24h`.
alex: excellent — update: customs cleared, but still recommend proceed with depot refurb plan as fallback (patch window).
vendor-ops: noted. will hold air redirect until EOD. booking pending on your confirmation.
chris: action items: 1) maria/finance approve PO amendment 2) elaine throttle noncritical jobs + update console 3) sudhir enable canary routing 4) vendor-ops hold booking until EOD.
maria: I'll get finance signoff, aim before 18:00 CET.
sudhir: canary live, metrics dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/telemetry/route-canary-1778881234
elaine: console banner updated: "Temporary capacity constraints in EU; some noncritical jobs may be delayed. We're working on expedited replacements."
alex: thanks team. I'll follow up tomorrow with final shipping decision once finance confirms. :thumbsup:
